android.desc:
Calendar+ is your all-in-one calendar, planner, and schedule manager designed for professionals and individuals who need advanced features with a clean and efficient interface. Whether you’re managing personal appointments, work meetings, family events, or shared schedules, Calendar+ provides all the tools you need in one intuitive app.

With seamless two-way sync for Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Exchange, and other popular services, Calendar+ ensures that your events stay up to date across all your devices. From advanced widgets to custom event views and productivity features, Calendar+ is built for those who want more than just a basic calendar.

⸻

🔑 Key Features at a Glance
	•	All-in-One Calendar App: Combine multiple calendars, from work to personal, and manage them from a single interface.
	•	Custom Calendar Priority: Set the display priority of each calendar so you see what matters most first.
	•	Copy and Move Events: Effortlessly duplicate or move events across calendars for better organization and planning.
	•	Multiple Viewing Modes: Switch between day, week, month, year, agenda, and custom views depending on your needs.
	•	Customizable Range: Set your calendar to show 2-day, 4-day, or multi-week views for improved clarity.
	•	Home Screen Widgets: Access your schedule at a glance with beautifully designed calendar widgets. Choose from various widget sizes and over 50 visual themes.
	•	Instant Calendar Sync: Real-time synchronization with Google, Outlook, Exchange, and more to keep your events consistent.
	•	Personalized Reminders & Notifications: Get alerts tailored to each event so you never miss an important meeting or occasion.
	•	Quick Event Creation: Add, edit, and search for events easily with natural language input and advanced filters.
	•	Dark Mode & Custom Themes: Make your calendar suit your style and reduce eye strain.

⸻

📌 Why Choose Calendar+?

Unlike basic calendar apps, Calendar+ provides professional-grade tools that make managing your schedule both efficient and enjoyable. It’s ideal for entrepreneurs, freelancers, office workers, students, and anyone who needs a calendar that works as hard as they do.

You can view multiple calendars in one place, highlight specific ones with custom colors or display priority, and tailor event views to your liking. Whether you’re planning a team meeting, personal workout schedule, or family dinner, Calendar+ helps you stay on top of everything.

quotes.text:
I'm assuming you're looking for the monthly planner view that actually shows events and not just indicators? Try calendar widgets suite or business calendar 2 planner. Unfortunately both are ad-supported (anything designed explicitly to show local personal information shouldn't go online IMHO), but there's a paid version as well. There's a couple other apps that have similar looking widgets as well, you might find more by searching for monthly planner widgets, not calendar widgets. It might also be possible to find one using a week toolkit (I used Zooper in the past, but I think it's pretty dead now; not sure what's replaced it).
